descFull: ResumeForge: a professional resume editor with a local AI workbench — fine-grained layout and typography control, a fact ledger that blocks fabrication, multi-format export, plus job tracking, mock interviews, an application desk and job-search analytics. FastAPI + React + SQLite; no account, data stays on your machine.
